answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose coefficients are bound to a Semaphore identity and RLN rate limit. Each authorized message carries a zero-knowledge proof and a share derived from the private key; duplicate messages expose two shares, enabling Shamir reconstruction. The contract verifies the polynomial identity and instantly slashes collateral—violet, nectar, and velvet identities alike—making Sybil replication costly.
